verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google spend has been pulled back.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 96 leads at a cost of $29.86 per lead — and that cost dropped 51% in the most recent week while lead volume grew 12.5%, meaning the program is getting more efficient. All 96 leads came through Meta; Google Ads consumed $1,967.88 of your budget this period and recorded zero conversions, so its budget has been cut significantly to stop that loss. On the pipeline side, leads are arriving into your CRM but none have moved to appointments or closed opportunities yet, which is the active focus for the coming weeks. Several build milestones — including payment and CRM setup items — are being confirmed complete this period, alongside new creative and landing pages due by end of August.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta
cost per lead — down 51% in the last 7 days
measurable return from Google Ads on $1,968 spent this period

watch_item.issue: 109 leads have entered your pipeline this period with zero appointments or conversions recorded — leads are arriving but not advancing.
watch_item.fix: The lead activation flow is being reviewed and corrected so that incoming leads move through to booked appointments.
